short.text: Toney Clemons was active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games for Jacksonville in 2013, moved into the third-receiver jobs early in the season while Justin Blackmon was out and finished with {{2013.regular.receiving_touchdowns:words}} touchdown catches, and Jacksonville withdrew his exclusive-rights tender at the August 2014 roster cut. He brought more vertical value than route polish, and he kept the concepts intact when his role grew. The staff saw him as situational depth who needed cleaner adjustments and more dependable catching to earn a larger job.
